Schedules verified transactions into microblocks and handles leader transitions, bundles, and metrics.

# Purpose
This file defines the `pack` tile for the transaction pipeline. It is a C source file that builds and schedules verified transactions into microblocks, sends those microblocks to bank tiles, and sends slot completion data to the PoH tile. The code manages leader transitions, slot limits, pacing, transaction expiration, and bank busy state. It also supports bundle handling, including bundle crank generation, signing, and insertion of initializer bundles when bundle mode is enabled.

The file contains the full tile implementation: scratch memory sizing, privileged and unprivileged setup, seccomp and file descriptor policy, and the runtime callbacks used by `fd_stem.c`. The main runtime logic is in [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>), [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>), [`before_credit`](<#before_credit>), [`after_credit`](<#after_credit>), and [`during_housekeeping`](<#during_housekeeping>), which process incoming transactions and control when microblocks are scheduled or completed. It also maintains metrics, handles optional extra transaction storage, and updates consensus-related limits and state for the current leader slot.
